topic: Snow day: the first time Mishi and Bruno see snow.

episode.title: Mishi & Bruno: Their First Snow Day!

shots.narration: Something fluffy is falling outside—and it isn't kitten fur!
shots.scene: Cosy colourful living room, tall window overlooking a snowy garden, warm morning sunlight, rounded 3D family-animation style, vertical 9:16, no text.
shots.action: Mishi and Bruno press their noses against the window beneath drifting snowflakes.
shots.mood: Wide green kitten eyes, lifted floppy puppy ears, golden indoor light.

shots.narration: Their familiar garden has become a soft, white wonderland.
shots.scene: Open garden doorway beside snow-covered flowerpots, sunny winter garden, soft colourful 3D animation, vertical 9:16, no text.
shots.action: Bruno gently presses one front paw into fresh snow.
shots.mood: Curious tilted puppy head, sparkling powder, warm sunlight.

shots.narration: [giggles] Bruno's very first footprint looks like a tiny flower!
shots.scene: Fresh snow outside the garden doorway, one clear pawprint, rounded 3D animation, vertical 9:16, no text.
shots.action: Mishi points one grey paw toward Bruno's footprint.
shots.mood: Mishi's bright green eyes, Bruno's proud smile, glittering snow.

shots.narration: Bruno decides to build the tallest snow tower ever.
shots.scene: Sunny garden clearing with a narrow stack of uneven snowballs, colourful fence behind, 3D animation, vertical 9:16, no text.
shots.action: Bruno balances a large snowball atop the narrow stack.
shots.mood: Playful concentration, floppy ears, visibly wobbly snowballs.

shots.narration: But his wobbly tower settles into a snowy pancake.
shots.scene: Snowy garden clearing beside the uneven snow tower, soft warm sunlight, rounded 3D animation, vertical 9:16, no text.
shots.action: The snow tower slumps into a low powdery mound before the friends.
shots.mood: Bruno's drooping ears, Mishi's thoughtful expression, harmless soft snow.

shots.narration: [excited] Mishi knows their tower needs a wider bottom.
shots.scene: Sunny garden clearing with the flattened snow mound, rich colourful fence, 3D animation, vertical 9:16, no text.
shots.action: Mishi pats the mound into a broad, flat-topped base.
shots.mood: Careful little paws, focused green eyes, Bruno watching attentively.

shots.narration: Bruno rolls a smaller snowball for the middle.
shots.scene: Smooth snowy garden path leading toward the broad snow base, 3D animation, vertical 9:16, no text.
shots.action: Bruno rolls a medium snowball along the short garden path.
shots.mood: Eager puppy grin, blue collar, soft snow curling ahead.

shots.narration: Together, they lift it onto Mishi's sturdy base.
shots.scene: Sunny garden clearing with a broad snow base, rounded friendly 3D animation, vertical 9:16, no text.
shots.action: Mishi and Bruno jointly place the medium snowball onto the broad base.
shots.mood: Matching determined smiles, paws supporting one snowball, warm winter glow.

shots.narration: [whispers] One tiny snowball goes right on top.
shots.scene: Low two-tier snow tower in the sunny garden, colourful fence behind, 3D animation, vertical 9:16, no text.
shots.action: Mishi carefully places a tiny snowball on the tower's middle tier.
shots.mood: Delicate paw placement, Bruno's expectant eyes, softly sparkling snow.

shots.narration: Bruno adds a leaf, their tower's finishing touch.
shots.scene: Stable three-tier snow tower beside a snow-dusted garden shrub, 3D animation, vertical 9:16, no text.
shots.action: Bruno places a small fallen leaf flat on the tower's top.
shots.mood: Proud puppy smile, Mishi's delighted eyes, bright green leaf.

shots.narration: Their little tower stands tall beside a mysterious mitten.
shots.scene: Completed snow tower in the garden, one purple mitten partly buried nearby, warm sunny 3D animation, vertical 9:16, no text.
shots.action: Mishi and Bruno lean back to admire their sturdy snow tower.
shots.mood: Relaxed happy faces, balanced snow tiers, purple mitten visible below.

shots.narration: [excited] Teamwork builds wonders; tomorrow, let's explore that mysterious mitten!
shots.scene: Sunny snowy garden beside the completed leaf-topped tower and purple mitten, cosy 3D animation, vertical 9:16, no text.
shots.action: Mishi lifts the purple mitten from the snow beside Bruno.
shots.mood: Curious green eyes, perked floppy ears, powder falling from purple wool.

episode.endHook: Tomorrow, they'll explore a mysterious mitten in the snow!
episode.description: Mishi and Bruno discover their garden covered in snow for the very first time! A wobbly snow tower teaches them that wonderful things happen when friends work together.
